# SwiGLU prefill, generated by stream-dse

`(SiLU(x @ w_gate) * (x @ w_up)) @ w_down` over `(seq_len, embedding_dim)` rows,
with `(in, out)` weights. Its design is not written here:
[stream-dse](https://github.com/KULeuven-MICAS/stream) partitions the block into
fused groups, places every layer, and generates each group's design.

```python
from iron.operators.swiglu_prefill_stream.graph import SwiGLUPrefillStream

ffn = SwiGLUPrefillStream(w_gate, w_up, w_down)
y = ffn(x)
```

## What stream-dse is given and what it returns

| | Source |
|---|---|
| Workload | `design.SwiGLU`, a `torch.nn.Module`, exported to ONNX (`iron/common/stream/workload.py`) |
| Candidate mappings | `design.candidates`: each partition and GEMM block, its layers' kernel arguments and fused groups |
| Kernels | mlir-aie's `aie.iron.kernels` factories, described in `iron/common/stream/kernels/aie2p.toml` |

`select_mapping` prices every candidate by its solve and the dispatches between
its groups, and the cheapest is built. Each fused group's design comes back as
MLIR with the kernels it calls (`final.mlir`, `kernels.json`), and is a
`StreamOperator` (`iron/common/stream/operator.py`) whose `exported_design()`
returns it. The solve is cached under `$NPU_CACHE_HOME/stream/`.

## Partitions

| `k` | Groups | Operators |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `gate, up, silu, mul, down` | `SwiGLUFusedStream` |
| 5 | one per layer | `SwiGLUProjectionStream` (gate, up, down), `SwiGLUSiLUStream`, `SwiGLUMulStream` |

`SwiGLUPrefillStream` is the graph over them: one step for the fused block,
or a step per group, which the full ELF dispatches in turn. `k` and
`gemm_block` narrow what stream-dse chooses between; left `None`, it chooses.
A GEMM block is the `(sequence, embedding, hidden)` block the tile search
starts from; a block no core can hold is refused by the solve.

`seq_len` must be a multiple of the array's rows and hold a block on each;
`embedding_dim` and `hidden_dim` multiples of their block times the column
split. A candidate that does not divide is left out (`design.fits`).

## Installing

```bash
pip install -r requirements_stream.txt
stream-setup-aie
```

Without stream-dse the operators are unresolvable and their tests skip.
